blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Evaluate five minus two x squared plus three x, when x equals negative three.
Replace each x with negative three, in parentheses.
Exponent first, before any multiplication. Negative three squared is nine.
Now the multiplications. Two times nine is eighteen, and three times negative three is negative nine.
Left to right: five minus eighteen is negative thirteen.
Negative thirteen plus negative nine is negative twenty-two.
So the answer is negative twenty-two.
Watch out for these traps. If you square two x together, you get negative forty. If you turn plus three x into minus three x, you get negative four.
